title: Classification of Yoneda extensions by derived Ext without enough projectives or injectives

standard_prerequisites.name: Derived-category calculus of fractions
standard_prerequisites.statement: Morphisms in D(A) are roofs in the homotopy category with quasi-isomorphism denominators; equality admits a common denominator after homotopy adjustments. Standard good truncations and pushouts in an abelian category may be used.

core_obligations: Construct an exact Yoneda extension from a roof B[0]←L→A[i] by truncation and the quotient pushout (L^(-i+1)⊕A)/L^(-i).
Turn equality of derived Ext classes into a common roof and a common extension mapping to both given extensions, obtaining the converse classification direction.
difficulty_reason: The proof must construct actual exact extensions from derived roofs and recover equivalence from a common denominator; neither direction is just the definition of Ext.
